prompt: Undo in a text editor reverses the most recent change first.
trap: A queue would undo the oldest change first.

prompt: A tool checks that every opening bracket in code has a matching closing bracket.
why: The latest open bracket must close first: a stack.
trap: Order matters, so a set can't do it.

prompt: A browser's Back button returns to the page you were on just before.
tells: the page you were on just before
why: Most recent page first: a stack.
trap: Pages link like a graph, but Back uses a stack.

prompt: In a cafeteria you take the top plate, which was the last one put there.
trap: The first plate stacked is taken last.

prompt: A function calls another, which calls another, and each returns to the one that called it.
tells: returns to the one that called it
trap: The calls can form a tree over time, but returning uses a stack.

prompt: Reverse a word by pushing its letters in and popping them out.
tells: pushing its letters in and popping them out
why: Push and pop are stack moves.
trap: A queue would give the word back unchanged.
